name: Istanbul Kultur University
description: Istanbul Kultur University started its education activities in higher education with 157 students and 32 academic staff in 1997−1998 academic year. In the 1997-1998 academic year, the Faculty of Arts and Sciences, the Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences (three faculties, namely the Faculty of Engineering and Architecture; In the fields of Business Administration Program and Computer Programming, Vocational Schools of Business Administration and Technical Sciences with 157 students and an academic staff of 32 people. started its activities.
